# Bundled dependencies

These files are part of the HipFalcons repository; neither directory is a
submodule.

| Directory | Source | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Falcons](Falcons) | [opensdc-org/Falcons at 6312f4c](https://github.com/opensdc-org/Falcons/tree/6312f4ce2642ba9efab7dcd0f0caf6a94c6278d5) | Unmodified tracked source from the CPU Falcons revision used by HipFalcons. |
| [zstd](zstd) | [Zstd v1.4.5](https://github.com/facebook/zstd/tree/v1.4.5) | Library sources (`lib/`), `LICENSE`, and `COPYING` from the upstream tag, used only when a system Zstd is not selected. |

Upstream license files and notices are preserved in both directories.
The Zstd source snapshot came from the upstream GitHub tag archive
(`sha256:734d1f565c42f691f8420c8d06783ad818060fc390dee43ae0a89f86d0a4f8c2`).
